description: A utility class providing backward-compatible access to specific methods of android.view.ScaleGestureDetector, enabling support for different Android API levels.

classes.name: ScaleGestureDetectorCompat
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to access ScaleGestureDetector features in a backward-compatible manner.

methods.name: getCurrentSpanX
methods.description: Returns the current horizontal span from ScaleGestureDetector, using the method appropriate for the device's API level.

methods.name: getCurrentSpanY
methods.description: Returns the current vertical span from ScaleGestureDetector, using the method appropriate for the device's API level.
